cohort: Twin infants born between 34+0 and 36+6 weeks gestational age in Emilia Romagna, Italy, during 2013-2015.
finding: Gestational age at delivery was the main determinant of adverse perinatal outcomes in late preterm twins, with lower gestational ages associated with higher rates of adverse outcomes, while the indication for delivery (spontaneous vs. indicated) did not significantly affect these outcomes.
